goal: A durable offline House of Ideas shared with a persistent Socrates resident, contextual dialogue, learning and owner-approved physical improvements.

canonical_source.note: GitHub is canonical for the local edition. Source publication is verified separately in the release task.

local_edition.packaged_distribution: Separate Windows portable deliverable; no GitHub Release asset has been published.
local_edition.resident: Persistent local philosopher using room purposes, actual activities, journal evidence and refusal memory; proposals include practice and next-visit tests. Offline dialogue is a rule-based guide.
local_edition.physical_approval: Only an explicit owner approval installs a bounded additive furnishing or learning book. Declines preserve the room.
local_edition.daily_review: The running local server checks from 21:00 Europe/Prague with the browser closed and catches up on missed recorded days at startup. A pending next-day critique connects the visited room to a learning book and, when justified, a bounded furnishing with concept, practice and next-visit test. Only recorded owner approval creates a neighbouring edition. Older book-only reviews remain valid. Stopping the server pauses checks; no unattended GPT or repository writes occur.

optional_gpt.network: Explicit online send only; bounded room context, goals, reflections, observations, decisions, designer metadata and recent dialogue.
optional_gpt.verification: Mocked Responses transport and strict structured-result validation passed in isolated tests.

local_edition.handoff: Explicit local ChatGPT-plan dialogue → private conversation JSON export → owner-initiated cloud import → owner-authored draft → separate approval → transcript-free referenced development brief → reviewed source change and verification. No automatic source writes.

verification.browser_rendering: Temporary local browser verified full eight-floor tower, top-floor central hall with embodied Socrates, subject guide, quantifier exercise, saved reflection and reload, explicit unsent resident discussion, sandboxed Atlas Geometry lens and Riemann profile. No live GPT or physical headset used.
verification.daily_critique: Prague/DST cutoff, enabled/activity gates, startup catch-up, latest-only pending reviews, exact archives/cities/decisions, no-op persistence, CAS, restart/shutdown, historical book compatibility, purpose-aware furnishing, explicit next-day atomic approval, declined/capacity/duplicate protection and derived-home reflection draft retention passed. Real browser review and approved Living room discussion circle/book in a separate edition verified in temporary data.

optional_chatgpt.connection: Separate, explicit Continue with ChatGPT OAuth for eligible plans; never reads Codex credentials.
optional_chatgpt.model: Selected from the connected account model catalog.
optional_chatgpt.token_storage: Server memory only; sign in again after stopping.
optional_chatgpt.verification: Mocked PKCE, nonce, JWKS identity, renewal, cancellation, dynamic catalog and bounded streamed response tests passed. Optional registration damage preserves offline startup.

conversation_archive.behavior: Atomic append preservation beyond recent 80-message resident windows; copied-home deduplication; includes distinct artist histories; no pruning at capacity. Old retained dialogue is backfilled on export without rewriting house bytes. Previously discarded messages cannot be recovered.

neighborhood.migration_backup: data/house-before-neighborhood.json preserves the original storage envelope byte for byte.
neighborhood.editions: Complete independent house documents. Spatial or object-function changes create another home; older homes remain read-only and visitable.
neighborhood.appearance: Legacy houses retain legacy-scene.js; inhabited houses retain inhabited-scene-v1.js; atelier remains the designer renderer. New residence editions use residence-scene-v1.js and residence-interior-v1.js, with physical floors, paintings and independent room atmosphere.
neighborhood.object_functions: Selectable offline books have pages and reflection questions. Assigned idea objects support reading, questioning, experiments and reflection.
neighborhood.verification: Atomic migration, full-history isolation, selected-home restart, furniture-aware paths, dense object placement, usable book spines, activity save races and assistant edits preserving object functions passed. Exact publication results are recorded separately in the release notes.
neighborhood.room_guide: Your home · Socrates identifies personal editions separately from Artists’ City. Map & ideas shows selectable floor plans, room purposes, actual object functions, painting descriptions and full idea notes; explicit destination assignments build an independent neighbouring residence.

residence.floors: One to three connected physical floors, spaced 3.4 metres apart. Stair landing selection transfers to the actual paired elevated floor; continuous stair walking is not implemented.
residence.room_controls: Names and purposes, per-room brightness from 0–100, entry writing up to 1,000 characters, up to three local attributed paintings, and complete idea reassignment.
residence.history: Room-guide and map commits explicitly build a new whole house. Older editions, notes, conversations, decisions and custom JSON metadata remain available. No pending AI proposal is approved by a design edit.
residence.limits: Up to 16 rooms, 12 ideas per room, 8 adjacent-floor stairs and 128 preserved personal houses. Reducing occupied floors requires moving their rooms first.
residence.verification: Actual temporary HTTP app/room/map saves, failure/reload draft retention, CAS and restart; whole archived documents and cities exact; physical stairs, painting/window/door clearance, lower-roof separation, room lighting, floor collision and GLB placement; browser map assignment, saved third floor, paintings and entry writing passed.

formats: Portable JSON design package with embedded GLBs
designer_contributions.assets: Immutable SHA256 files in data/designs; no external resources or executable imports.
designer_contributions.homes: GLB houses are garden exhibits with ground-level full-size tours; app house templates make independent neighbouring homes.
designer_contributions.limits: 12 MiB per GLB, 24 designs per home, 512 instanced draws per GLB; combined geometry/texture/draw budgets enforced.
designer_contributions.sharing: A package includes one home and its personal memories; data-folder backup preserves the whole neighbourhood.
designer_contributions.verification: Actual HTTP uploads, exact bytes/restart, CAS, old-house isolation, placement and transform controls, activity drafts, portable package preflight and geometry/resource budgets passed.

virtual_reality.interface: WebXR immersive-vr on a compatible headset/browser and secure origin.
virtual_reality.controls: Trigger selection/ground teleport, left-stick movement, right-stick snap turn, in-world reading/critique panel.
virtual_reality.verification: Rig/head world transforms, collision axes, stable pivot, selected-floor teleport, landing transfers, elevated seating/standing and desktop restoration tested with mocks; real headset hardware remains unverified.
virtual_reality.scope: Single-player exploration with floor-aware rig height and explicit landing selection in personal residences and the eight-floor Mathematics Institute; the full Atlas reader remains a browser interface. No continuous stair walking, CAD/BIM editor, shared world, marketplace or arbitrary device connection.

artists_city.residents: Ten distinct embodied artist residents, each living and exploring inside their own gallery house. Socrates remains in the personal neighbourhood, Makers City and Mathematics City.
artists_city.conversation: Ten distinct interpretive artist personas; explicit optional ChatGPT plan or API conversations grounded in their own works, recent private dialogue and gallery history. Offline art guides remain available.
artists_city.persistence: Optional artistConversations and artistHomes preserve separate chats and decisions, CAS across the whole store, immutable retained conversation prefixes and decided gallery history. Every complete personal home and Socrates memory is preserved.
artists_city.privacy: Online requests send only selected-artist context after explicit send. Learning collection exports exclude chats and gallery decisions. Approved GitHub briefs name included design fields and exclude transcripts; data-folder backup retains all private material.
artists_city.verification: Forty source suites and both builds passed. Mocked OAuth, catalogue, artist API/SSE, provider cancellation and actual temp HTTP restart/CAS; 20 new lots, 120 copied works, 20 exercises and 181 routes; browser approval and embodied resident arrival in the new Monet gallery. Live owner sign-in/inference remains unverified.
artists_city.editions: Owner edits and approves bounded design proposals; each approval makes a separate roofed gallery lot with an atmosphere and functional learning object. Originals and up to 20 approved editions remain walkable and inhabited.

chatgpt_connection_fix.verification: Large valid 160KB catalogue accepted; over-budget bodies, hidden records, malformed catalogues, body cancellation/timeouts and intact session checked using mocks. Public JWKS/discovery are small; protected catalogue is the likely cause of the reported error.

mathematics_city.building: Independent Mathematics Institute, eight physical floors at four-metre spacing, complete facade and roof, selected-floor study furniture, explicit lift/stair transfers and central-hall arrivals.
mathematics_city.learning: 24 selectable books, diagram boards and idea objects with explanations, questions, exercises and source links. The guide lists subjects and floor destinations. Mathematical discussions prepare an unsent Socrates question; no automatic online request.
mathematics_city.persistence: Independent city journal and ground-floor cargo copies. Existing three-city records retain their exact shape until a mathematics visit is recorded. Saving city notes preserves all complete personal homes, resident memories, artist conversations and approved editions.

atlas.content: Actual deployed self-contained reader: 131 thinkers, 181 connections, eight trails and thirteen idea lenses.
atlas.loading: Explicit monitor selection only. Opaque sandbox with scripts and downloads, no same-origin access. Only this exact local HTML path permits same-origin framing; no broad CSP relaxation.
atlas.notes: Embedded reader notes and shelf are session-only; explicit JSON export retains them. City reflections persist separately in the offline house. No automatic Atlas synchronization.

mathematics_city.verification: Six focused suites passed: bounded data, draft-preserving UI and explicit reader actions, physical geometry/ray selection/collision/resources, 20 actual coordinator desktop/mocked-XR transfers, exact Atlas HTTP/script/framing policy, and genuine legacy-data city-save/restart/conflict preservation. Browser checks are recorded separately.
mathematics_city.limits: Floor transfers are explicit, not continuous stair walking. Physical VR and live GPT remain unverified. Public preview uses in-memory state. Atlas external reading uses the explicit original-online link.
mathematics_city.packaged_verification: Passed actual bundled Windows Node launch, graceful CLI stop, saved mathematics journal and three cargo anchors, exact restart, old three-city shape and complete three-home/artist-history fixture preservation; no provider calls or owner data used.

private_online_edition.persistence: User-scoped D1 neighbourhood, artist/city records, append-only conversation archive and separately approved development briefs. Revision checks and atomic quota enforcement preserve saved state.
private_online_edition.conversation_transfer: Explicit JSON selection and import; no automatic local/cloud synchronization. Original source-place labels retained; exact hash duplicates skipped; house data and approval authority never imported from conversation files.
private_online_edition.inference: Rule-based hosted residents. Hosted ChatGPT sign-in provides identity only. Eligible-plan inference is available through the explicitly connected localhost house; separately billed hosted APIs are disabled by owner preference.
private_online_edition.limits: 10,000 messages and 1,000 briefs; 1.3 MB mutation bodies; full file selection up to 192 MiB, then bounded sequential imports. Full export materializes the archive in memory. GLB imports remain offline-only; no unattended GPT or repository editing.
private_online_edition.verification: Real SQLite identity/isolation/CAS/rollback/import/retention/quota races/brief approval and restart tests passed. Temporary browser verified draft, separate approval, approved-file export, reload and repeat-import deduplication. Production publication and identity checks recorded separately. Hosted gallery build script execution, exact reconstruction and188 assets below25MiB passed.
